# Jobberman Nigeria Job Market Scraper

Jobberman is Nigeria's largest job board, and this actor turns its public listings into a clean, analysis-ready dataset. Run a keyword search with any combination of state, industry, job function, work type and experience filters, replay a search you built in your browser, or paste specific job URLs. Every record carries the title, employer, location, salary (when the employer publishes it), requirements, full description and application metadata that Jobberman shows publicly.

The actor uses plain HTTP, needs no login, cookies or API key, and omits fields the source did not publish instead of returning empty strings or nulls.

## What you can scrape

- **Keyword and filter search** — search the live board by keyword, state or region, industry, job function, work type, experience band and sort order (Latest, Featured, Popular), with automatic pagination.
- **Replay search URLs** — paste one or more filtered Jobberman search or category URLs; the actor follows the same filters and pages through the results.
- **Specific job URLs** — fetch a fixed list of listing pages for exact lookups, backfills or monitoring.
- **Optional detail enrichment** — open each listing's own page for the full description, exact posting and closing dates, structured salary, education and experience requirements, work mode and badges. Turn it off for faster card-only records.
- **Post-fetch filters** — salary band, minimum posting age and a required keyword are applied after fetching, so jobs with undisclosed salary or dates are never silently dropped.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `"search"` | `search` for keyword/filter search, `bySearchUrls` to replay search URLs, or `byUrls` for specific listing URLs. |
| `searchQuery` | string | `"sales"` | Keyword, job title, skill or company name. Empty means browse all listings. Legacy `query`, `keyword` and `keywords` keys are mapped in code. |
| `searchQueries` | array | `[]` | Extra keyword searches to run in the same job. Results are deduplicated by listing URL. |
| `location` | string | Any location | Nigerian state or region, `remote`, `outside-nigeria`, or `nigeria` for the whole country. |
| `industry` | string | Any industry | Employer industry, from advertising to tourism. |
| `jobFunction` | string | Any job function | Job family such as Software & Data, Sales or Accounting, Auditing & Finance. |
| `workType` | string | Any work type | Jobberman's work-type groups: Full Time, Part Time, Contract & Temporary, Internship & Volunteer, Casual & Seasonal. |
| `experienceLevel` | string | Any experience level | No Experience, Internship & Graduate, Entry, Mid, Senior or Executive level. |
| `employmentType` | string | Any type | Post-filter on the normalised type: `fullTime`, `partTime`, `contract`, `internship`, `temporary` or `volunteer`. |
| `sortBy` | string | `"latest"` | Jobberman's own `latest`, `featured` or `popular` order, preserved across pages. |
| `postedWithinDays` | integer | `0` | Keep jobs posted in the last N days; `0` keeps any date. Jobs with no date are kept. |
| `minSalary` | integer | – | Drop jobs whose disclosed band is entirely below this monthly NGN amount. Undisclosed salaries pass through. |
| `maxSalary` | integer | – | Drop jobs whose disclosed band is entirely above this monthly NGN amount. Undisclosed salaries pass through. |
| `containsKeyword` | string | – | Case-insensitive substring that must appear in the title, company, summary or description. |
| `listingUrls` | array | `[]` | Direct listing URLs for `mode=byUrls`. |
| `searchUrls` | array | `[]` | Filtered Jobberman search or category URLs for `mode=bySearchUrls`. |
| `includeFullDescription` | boolean | `true` | Fetch each listing page for descriptions, exact dates, structured salary and requirements. |
| `maxItems` | integer | `30` | Hard cap on records pushed (1–10,000). |
| `maxPages` | integer | `0` | Safety cap on search pages per source; `0` chooses a cap from `maxItems`. |

### Example: Lagos sales jobs with full details

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "searchQuery": "sales",
  "location": "lagos",
  "jobFunction": "sales",
  "experienceLevel": "mid-level",
  "includeFullDescription": true,
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: replay a filtered search

```json
{
  "mode": "bySearchUrls",
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.jobberman.com/jobs/software-data/lagos?experience=senior-level&sort=popular",
    "https://www.jobberman.com/jobs?q=accountant&work_type=full-time"
  ],
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

### Example: fetch exact listings

```json
{
  "mode": "byUrls",
  "listingUrls": [
    "https://www.jobberman.com/listings/account-assistant-8mnppx",
    "https://www.jobberman.com/listings/sales-manager-qz6pqj"
  ]
}
```

## Output per job

Every record is a flat JSON object. Fields are omitted when Jobberman did not publish that value.

- `jobId`, `jobSlug`, `sourceUrl` — stable identifiers and the canonical listing URL.
- `title`, `companyName`, `companyLogoUrl` — employer identity; the generic Jobberman placeholder logo is removed.
- `location`, `locationSlug`, `isRemote` — display location, machine-friendly slug and remote flag.
- `employmentType`, `employmentTypes`, `workType`, `workTypeSlug` — normalised employment type plus Jobberman's own work-type group.
- `category`, `jobFunctionSlug`, `industry`, `industrySlug` — job family and employer industry.
- `salaryMin`, `salaryMax`, `salaryCurrency`, `salaryPeriod`, `salaryText`, `salaryDisclosed` — structured NGN salary when disclosed; `Confidential` is reported as `salaryDisclosed: false`.
- `experienceLevel`, `experienceLevelSlug`, `experienceMonths`, `experienceLengthText`, `educationLevel` — requirements as stated.
- `summary`, `descriptionHtml`, `descriptionText` — short teaser and full job description.
- `languages`, `workingHours`, `applicantLocation` — additional requirements shown on the detail page.
- `datePosted`, `datePostedRelative`, `validThrough` — exact dates and the site's relative label.
- `addressLocality`, `addressRegion`, `addressCountry` — location components from structured data.
- `directApply`, `isFeatured`, `isNew`, `isPopular`, `isEasyApply` — application and badge flags.
- `searchUrl`, `searchQuery` — the search that produced the record, when applicable.
- `recordType` (`job`) and `scrapedAt`.

Typical fill rates from a live sample of 55 listings: structured posting data 100%, language requirement 100%, salary 76%, education 91%, remote flag 15%. The remaining values are genuinely absent on Jobberman, not extraction failures.

## Use cases

- Recruitment teams monitoring openings by state, function or industry.
- Salary research using the disclosed NGN bands and pay periods.
- Job boards and aggregators backfilling Nigerian listings.
- Labour-market dashboards tracking hiring demand and remote share.
- Career coaches and jobseekers watching new roles matching a keyword.

## FAQ

**Is this actor affiliated with Jobberman?**
No. It reads publicly available listing pages and is not operated or endorsed by Jobberman.

**Do I need a proxy, account or API key?**
No. The actor runs on plain HTTP with no login. It reads the same public pages a browser sees.

**Why are some salary fields missing?**
Many Nigerian employers publish "Confidential" or no figure. The actor reports `salaryText` and `salaryDisclosed` when it can, and never invents a number.

**What is the difference between `workType` and `employmentType`?**
`workType` is Jobberman's grouping (for example Contract & Temporary). `employmentType` is the normalised value from the listing's structured data (for example `contract`).

**Can I collect more than one location or function in a single run?**
Use `searchQueries` for multiple keywords, or `mode=bySearchUrls` with one URL per filter combination. Jobberman's own search accepts one value per facet, so replaying URLs is the reliable way to combine several.

**Are emails or phone numbers extracted from descriptions?**
No. Jobberman descriptions in the current site do not include contact details, and the actor does not fabricate them.

**How fresh is the data?**
Each run queries the live board. Use `sortBy: "latest"` plus `postedWithinDays` in a scheduled task for incremental monitoring.

**What happens when a search runs out of results?**
The actor stops on the site's own 404 or empty page, emits what it found, and sets a status message explaining the shortfall. It never loops to a wall-clock limit.

## Data source

Public Jobberman Nigeria listing and job-detail pages (`https://www.jobberman.com/jobs` and `https://www.jobberman.com/listings/...`). The actor uses schema.org `JobPosting` structured data when present and the site's visible cards and detail labels as fallbacks.
